verdict.rationale: Meilisearch can be self-hosted as a single binary on your own machines, so data stays on infrastructure you control. A community report also notes that its default-on analytics can be disabled via MEILI_NO_ANALYTICS. However, the evidence never documents document or index deletion APIs, retention policies, or deletion guarantees for stored embeddings, so control over retention is only implied. Missing for 10: documented document/index deletion endpoints, configurable retention or TTL policies, deletion guarantees for embeddings, analytics and Cloud data, and independent corroboration.
